# Proof & Realness

Legend: [D] demonstrated · [A] anticipated · [T] target.

- [T] The network is "viable and living, that is economically sustainable and growing." Stated as the achievement condition, not yet shown.
- [T] "A chance at out-computing the big foundation models." The summit metric; explicitly probabilistic ("a chance").
- [A] "42 billion in compute" as the scale of ask. A figure asserted in conversation, unverified within the transcript; no commitment shown.
- [A] Constituency demand treated as evidence the thing is wanted: data-dignity groups, Indigenous communities, governments "EU, UK," home labs, researchers all "care." Asserted, not measured.
- [A] Existing efforts "already underway" cited as proof of momentum, then deferred ("We'll come on to that"); unverified here.

**Headline metric.** Whether the networked sovereign compute is on a credible, reliably-statable path to "out-computing the big foundation models."
